up: Return a list of all compounds reported in the document with CHEMBL ID CHEMBL5726887. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), preferred name (pref_name), and compound key (compound_key).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cr.compound_key FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726887'
